beats.say: AI voiceover is a service small creators can sell. Here's the tool I'd test first: ElevenLabs.
Paste a script, pick a voice, adjust the delivery,
and download the audio for a client's video or ad.
The honest limit: the free plan gives ten thousand credits a month, but selling the audio needs a paid plan. Starter adds the commercial licence. Only clone a voice you have permission to use.
Free alternative: Kokoro, an open-source voice model. It's what this channel's voice runs on.
Disclosure: the link in my bio is my referral link, and I may earn a commission if you subscribe. Follow for one tool and one income stream every day.
